rows.quote: METHODS: We examined associations between 2922 plasma proteins and blood pressure (BP) traits (systolic BP [SBP] and diastolic BP [DBP], and prevalent hypertension) in 45 991 UK Biobank participants with validation in 5759 FHS (Framingham Heart Study) participants.
rows.coder_note: Step 3 of the decision order (rule C2, also rule C): the sentence names FHS (Framingham Heart Study) as the validation cohort of the authors' own protein-blood pressure analysis; the outcome side of the dictionary has no FHS row under any release (the only Framingham row is on the pqtl side). No release identifier, accession or citation, so step 2 does not apply; no accession, so rule C4 does not arise.
